test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Four of the following five are alike in a certain way and hence form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group?

1. ROSE: TQSC

2. LION : NKOL

3. BEAR: DAWT

4. CAND: ECNB

5. TIGER: VKGCP
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is: 

ROSE : TQSC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10f0d679ed6e4b23bd5479ae3e91e809f21398c4d1f99b8e1e8429fe9862274a.png] 

 

LION : NKOL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bbdd707b4e63a22ca6469e9aeabce1202923499c2165231aaa1eec3f139e568.png] 

 

CAND : ECNB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/274ca1fe0feb49a2869e13052c38a01d0314b92f5781cf85a859e2926adc32f0.png] 

 

BEAR : DAWT

This pair follows a different pattern of alphabetical shifts: `+2, -4, -4, +2`. This is the one that does not belong to the group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9abf0fd7735997c0bd8a58a49ddc59f54e7397ad5e011598a360076ca2026f94.png] 

 

TIGER : VKGCP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b0d30f41a46f76703cf354013e79250fa43a16cd9f44b53bad8e92e9618f706.png] 

 

Thus, the word pair that does not belong is **BEAR: DAWT** .

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1'.**
